tables.name: nafes_scan_sheets
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_scan_sheets_pkey ON public.nafes_scan_sheets USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_scan_sheets_session_id_ordinal_key ON public.nafes_scan_sheets USING btree (session_id, ordinal)
CREATE INDEX nafes_scan_sheets_identity_idx ON public.nafes_scan_sheets USING btree (review_pk, student_id, uploaded_at)
CREATE INDEX nafes_scan_sheets_image_idx ON public.nafes_scan_sheets USING btree (review_pk, image_hash)

constraints.name: nafes_scan_sheets_session_id_review_pk_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (session_id, review_pk) REFERENCES nafes_scan_sessions(id, review_pk)

tables.name: nafes_scan_sessions
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_scan_sessions_pkey ON public.nafes_scan_sessions USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_scan_sessions_id_review_pk_key ON public.nafes_scan_sessions USING btree (id, review_pk)
CREATE INDEX nafes_scan_sessions_review_idx ON public.nafes_scan_sessions USING btree (review_pk, created_at DESC)

constraints.name: nafes_scan_sessions_expected_page_count_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (expected_page_count IS NULL OR expected_page_count >= 1 AND expected_page_count <= 200)

constraints.name: nafes_scan_sessions_source_file_count_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (source_file_count IS NULL OR source_file_count >= 1 AND source_file_count <= 200)

tables.name: nafes_scan_answer_edits
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_scan_answer_edits_pkey ON public.nafes_scan_answer_edits USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_scan_answer_edits_sheet_id_answer_version_key ON public.nafes_scan_answer_edits USING btree (sheet_id, answer_version)
CREATE INDEX nafes_scan_answer_edits_sheet_idx ON public.nafes_scan_answer_edits USING btree (sheet_id, created_at)

tables.name: nafes_scan_identity_edits
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_scan_identity_edits_pkey ON public.nafes_scan_identity_edits USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX nafes_scan_identity_edits_sheet_idx ON public.nafes_scan_identity_edits USING btree (sheet_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX nafes_scan_identity_edits_reviewer_idx ON public.nafes_scan_identity_edits USING btree (reviewer_id)

constraints.name: nafes_scan_identity_edits_sheet_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (sheet_id) REFERENCES nafes_scan_sheets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: nafes_scan_alerts
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_scan_alerts_pkey ON public.nafes_scan_alerts USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_scan_alerts_sheet_id_key ON public.nafes_scan_alerts USING btree (sheet_id)
CREATE INDEX nafes_scan_alerts_review_idx ON public.nafes_scan_alerts USING btree (review_pk, created_at DESC)

tables.name: nafes_paper_reviews
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_paper_reviews_pkey ON public.nafes_paper_reviews USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_paper_reviews_owner_id_review_id_key ON public.nafes_paper_reviews USING btree (owner_id, review_id)
CREATE INDEX nafes_paper_reviews_owner_updated_idx ON public.nafes_paper_reviews USING btree (owner_id, updated_at DESC)

constraints.name: nafes_paper_reviews_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES nafes_teacher_access(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: nafes_paper_reviews_subjects_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (cardinality(subjects) >= 1 AND cardinality(subjects) <= 3 AND subjects <@ ARRAY['reading'::text, 'math'::text, 'science'::text])

tables.name: nafes_assessment_attempts
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_assessment_attempts_pkey ON public.nafes_assessment_attempts USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_assessment_attempts_assessment_id_student_key_attempt_key ON public.nafes_assessment_attempts USING btree (assessment_id, student_key, attempt_no)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nafes_assessment_active_student_idx ON public.nafes_assessment_attempts USING btree (assessment_id, student_key) WHERE (submitted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX nafes_assessment_history_idx ON public.nafes_assessment_attempts USING btree (student_key, started_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX nafes_assessment_expiry_idx ON public.nafes_assessment_attempts USING btree (expires_at) WHERE (submitted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX nafes_assessment_student_id_idx ON public.nafes_assessment_attempts USING btree (student_id)
CREATE INDEX nafes_assessment_real_attempts_idx ON public.nafes_assessment_attempts USING btree (is_demo, submitted_at)

triggers.name: nafes_snapshot_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER nafes_snapshot_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON nafes_assessment_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nafes_preserve_attempt_snapshot()

triggers.name: trg_lugati_assessment_adaptive
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_lugati_assessment_adaptive AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF submitted_at, answers, rendered_sections ON nafes_assessment_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION lugati_assessment_adaptive_trigger()

triggers.name: trg_lugati_ws_assessment
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_lugati_ws_assessment AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON nafes_assessment_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION lugati_attempt_worksheet_sync_trigger()

constraints.name: nafes_assessment_attempts_attempt_no_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (is_demo = true AND attempt_no >= 1 OR is_demo = false AND attempt_no >= 1 AND attempt_no <= 10)

constraints.name: nafes_assessment_attempts_student_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES nafes_students(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
